📊 #Laralyze is a self-hosted #observability dashboard for #Laravel apps. It records what your app does in production and shows it at /laralyze inside the app: requests, jobs, commands, queries, exceptions, cache, outgoing HTTP, AI calls, mail, notifications, logs, users, servers and visits. #PHP #opensource
